bottom: and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing...

bottom: as a burning fire shut up in my bones...

bottom: the way of life, and the way of death.

bottom: and write it in their hearts...

bottom: rising early and sending them...

bottom: in the latter days, saith the LORD...

bottom: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

bottom: and cast me behind thy back...
